sources.title: Qwen Image Edit 2511 (FP8) - AI Model Library | Build on Vast.ai
sources.snippet: Qwen Image Edit 2511 is the December 2025 release of the image editing model in the Qwen series, built on the Qwen Image foundation model. Where Qwen Image focuses on text-to-image generation, Qwen Image Edit takes one or more existing images plus a natural-language instruction and produces a precisely edited result.
